sloka: अनुगम्य निवृत्तानाम् रामम् नगर वासिनाम् ।उद्गतानि इव सत्त्वानि बभूवुर् अमनस्विनाम् ॥२-४८-२॥
transliteration: anugamya nivṛttānām rāmam nagara vāsinām ।udgatāni iva sattvāni babhūvur amanasvinām ॥2-48-2॥

translations.english: The people afflicted with sorrow followed Rama and returned to the city deeply distressed. Eyes overflowing with tears, they longed for death. Smitten with grief, they lost their highmindedness and looked as if their life had been drained out.
